item.title: Eviction Lawsuits Fly At New Affordable Housing Complex
item.description: One tenant of a brand new West River apartment complex saw her eviction case withdrawn Tuesday, while two of her neighbors saw their eviction cases continued to next month. Those households are just three of 22 at the 56-unit Curtis Cofield II Estates that have been hit with eviction lawsuits in recent months. The post Eviction Lawsuits Fly At New Affordable Housing Complex appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: City Supports Minnesota’s Anti-ICE-Occupation Lawsuit
item.description: The Elicker administration has joined 37 other local governments from across the country in signing on to an amicus brief calling for the Trump administration to end its "unlawful deployment" of federal immigration agents in Minneapolis and Saint Paul. item.title: Dillon Touts Experience, Targets Health Cuts
item.description: State Rep. Pat Dillon is keeping an eye on Washington -- and on Westville. She is monitoring Trump administration cuts to see what gaps the state can help New Haven fill to keep research labs running. Meanwhile, she is the only New Haven state legislator so far this year facing a serious Democratic primary challenge. The post Dillon Touts Experience, Targets Health Cuts appeared first on New Haven Independent.
